label: DOMAIN - Base Config
info:
Base configuration for DOMAIN automation domain.

This module contains:
- UI groups and page structure
- MQTT broker reference
- Common functions and utilities
- Context initialization

IMPORT THIS FIRST before importing feature modules.

Replace placeholders:
- DOMAIN: Your domain name (e.g., gate, light, irrigation)
- NUMBER: Your starting number (e.g., 200, 300, 400)
- MQTT_PREFIX: Your MQTT topic prefix (e.g., gates, lights, irrigation)
